violated_contract: An authority that admits tool invocations must compute its allowlist from the same manifest projection that advertised the tool to the invoking surface. The realtime-voice surface offers tools generated from the surface projection, but the kernel run-tool capability filtered by chat-adapter projection, structurally rejecting every voice-only tool (ask_higher_model, point_click) with tool_not_allowed.
canonical_prevention: Kernel run-tool capability registration unions the run surface's manifest projection (toolsForSurface) with the adapter projection, and a behavioral test registers a swift_realtime run and authorizes a voice-only tool end-to-end.
